open_screen_hint: Skill Tree (press A - your keybind). Paragon P, inventory I.
points_label: Available Points (top-left panel, number between two small diamonds)
tree_notes: Skill tree is a vertical chain of clusters (Basic, Core, Defensive/Macabre/etc, ..., Ultimate, Key Passive). Lower clusters unlock after spending enough points. Each active skill has an Enhanced upgrade then a pick-one of two upgrades. Left-click adds a point, right-click refunds. The tree scrolls; scroll down to reach later clusters. Paragon: boards connected through gates, glyph sockets, legendary node per board.
warning: Blizzard's Warden anti-cheat is stricter than Embark's. Default mode is 'guide' (hover + highlight, no clicking). Use --mode auto at your own risk.
_keys_note: D4 default PC binds (keybinds live on the Battle.net account, not in LocalPrefs.txt). Friends who remapped: edit here.

keys._paragon_note: no default key - Paragon is a tab in the Abilities panel (P = SHOP, never press it)
